title: Revisit starter adventure sourcing after module support
description:
Revisit the long-frozen starter-adventure sourcing work after Eshyra has a first-class module destination.

The old question of which starter adventure to use was premature because the project did not yet have a module schema, loader, campaign-owned binding/progress, or runtime integration. Once those exist, evaluate whether to keep using the first-party The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter content, add a legally safe third-party sample, or convert an external adventure only as a compatibility exercise.
design:
Do not convert third-party adventure content until all of the following hold:
- the immutable adventure module source schema exists (eshyra-eh54.2),
- the campaign-owned adventure run / module binding and progress state exists (eshyra-eh54.4),
- the first-party Emberfall / The Hollow Beneath Emberfall path proves the architecture end to end (eshyra-eh54.7 and children),
- and licensing is explicitly reviewed.

This bead should be mostly decision and scoping. It may close or replace the old frozen starter-content bead if that bead's original premise is obsolete.
acceptance_criteria:
- The existing frozen starter-content bead is reviewed in light of the new adventure-module architecture.
- A recommendation is recorded: keep first-party The Hollow Beneath Emberfall only, add a legally safe third-party sample, or create a conversion/import experiment.
- Third-party adventure content stays blocked until the module source schema, the campaign-owned module binding/progress, and the first-party Emberfall path all exist, and licensing is explicitly reviewed.
- Legal/licensing constraints are explicitly considered before any third-party adventure content is added.
- The decision does not block the first-party hello-world module.
- Any follow-up beads are created with clear scope if third-party content is still desired.
